common_frame: Corrected plume frame: x_p transverse/right of fitted axis, y_p axial along measured inclined plume; laboratory reference and inverse retained.
diameter_source_or_assumption: User-selected nominal model estimate: 5 um nominal mesh aperture, emerging jet diameter assumed equal to aperture; Rayleigh d_drop approximately 1.89*d_jet = 9.45 um, rounded to 10 um. Not measured sizing or a validated size distribution.

diameter_model.selection: Use droplet_diameters_um for every calculation; 9.45 um records motivation only. Replace configurable values and provenance when measured sizing is available.
diameter_model.applicability: Classical inviscid cylindrical-jet breakup motivates the estimate; applicability to this driven mesh atomiser and equality of emerging jet and aperture diameters are not validated.

release_definition: Fixed y_p entry plane; x_p offsets are configured integer offsets times the rotated native horizontal-grid transverse spacing. Four-finite-corner measured aligned components initialise each developed droplet.
properties_assumptions: Pressure 101325 Pa; water at the recorded air temperature of 20 C; dry-air properties approximate unknown humidity
local_stokes_timescale: D0 / norm(prescribed local mean gas velocity), not a nozzle-exit or forcing-frequency timescale

co_directed.reference_planes: Original source pairing X_ZNMF_mm = laboratory_y_PZT_mm - relative_axial_offset_mm is used only to identify entry. At entry align axes once; downstream gas is placed by rigid +90 degree jet-local-to-plume rotation with no axial stretch or recentering.
co_directed.plume_reference: Corrected fixed fitted straight axis x_p=0; no fixed laboratory-column reuse
co_directed.release_definition: Fixed y_p entry plane; x_p offsets are configured integer offsets times the rotated native horizontal-grid transverse spacing. Four-finite-corner measured aligned components initialise each developed droplet.
co_directed.comparison_coordinate_pairing: ZNMF downstream Xj [mm] is paired with original PZT laboratory height y_lab=Xj+offset; fitted-axis y_p=(y_lab-reference_y)/cos(theta). No pairing of new zero with nozzle origin.
